Describe what the original executable code actually does from a MASKED VIEW (not rewritten runtime code). Hidden docstring/comment metadata dependencies such as __doc__ are unknown: abstract operations, conditions and output effects. Cite provided original source IDs. Missing imported/global context is unknown. Do not invent intended requirements.
Return exactly ONE JSON object with the root keys shown below. items MUST be an array. Use only those root/item keys; do not output a schema description or instruction wrapper. Fill angle-bracket descriptions with your own concise claims. Only fields explicitly described as optional may be empty strings. status is ok, abstain or unknown. If abstaining use items=[] and a nonempty reason.
reason may be empty for status=ok. S1 ambiguity may be empty; eligibility is null or text.
Source is a masked VIEW of the original runtime code. Missing comments/docstrings alone do not make ordinary executable operations unknown. Only flag hidden-metadata uncertainty if the code actually depends on it. source_ids must be N aliases from source_nodes. guard='' means unconditional; effect='' means no separate observable effect described, while statement must still explain the operation. uncertainty may be empty. Maximum6 items.
Your output object must have this single shape (repeat item/decision objects as needed):
{"status": "ok", "reason": "", "items": [{"id": "B1", "statement": "<actual code behavior>", "source_ids": ["<exact provided source ID>"], "guard": "<condition>", "effect": "<effect on output>", "uncertainty": ""}]}
